findings.what: user input goes straight into an AI prompt (prompt injection)
findings.fix: Pass user text through a CODE node that trims, length-caps and wraps it in clear delimiters; tell the model to treat it as data; validate the model's JSON.

findings.what: `BILL_READ.json` webhook has no authentication — anyone who learns the URL can run it (the URL itself is the secret: it lives only in the app's server environment)
findings.fix: Header Auth on the trigger with a secret the app sends from the environment; reject a missing/wrong secret in the first CODE node.
